[SWS_DM_00160] Allow to clear single DTCs
⌈
If the configuration Diag-
nosticCommonProps.clearDtcLimitation is set to allSupportedDtcs, the
Diagnostic Server instance shall allow to clear single DTCs or DTCGroups.
[SWS_DM_00092] defines the possible and refused values.
